title: My 4-Tool Stack for solo mode
caption:
The tool stack mistake that's costing you your weekend

Most people get this wrong. Avoid these:
1️⃣ Make — visual automation builder — branching logic that Zapier charges more for
2️⃣ OpusClip — turns one long video into dozens of captioned short clips with virality scores
3️⃣ Zapier — connects 7000+ apps so a trigger in one fires an action in another
4️⃣ ManyChat — Instagram DM + comment automation — turns a comment into a conversation

Which one are you guilty of? Comment below.
